card.name: "To" after monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: The word "to" (or "help") that begins a purpose clause right after a monitoring or observation phrase, such as "monitor patients to" or "closely observed to". It predicts a verb like detect, ensure or determine.

modes.label: Monitoring then purpose
modes.description: "To" follows a phrase about monitoring, observing or checking levels, and introduces why.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "detect" and related verbs, and away from "cannot".
card.plain: It marks the spot after "monitor patients" where the text is about to say what the monitoring is meant to detect or ensure.
